reviews.title: fast and easy set up
reviews.comment: this beast has run all my programs at lightning speed. Was easy to set up. The print for the connection points is small, hard on old eyes. Good deal.
reviews.author: game player

reviews.title: Slow return process.
reviews.comment: Installed, powered up, CPU not recognized. Despite many attempts at troubleshooting, nothing. Error code reads "no cpu present" if the board, 13th gen. Isn't compatible with the CPU 14th gen, it shouldn't be sold as a "bundle." I returned item on January 1st, now January 11th, they say they'll review it January 23rd, and may take two weeks more to receive Amazon credit. 5 weeks later without my computer. So I ordered the same CPU but with a newer 14th gen motherboard. MSI board  this time. It's been rough.
reviews.author: Bjoerk
